name: IEA
description: Public energy highlights, country metadata and observations; paid and account-gated non-CC datasets are refused.

Each entry lists the stats code, the Monthly Electricity Statistics display name and the prices code it maps to, plus every alias `data` accepts.

tools.name: Data
tools.description: Observations from one free IEA dataset for the given countries (ISO3 or IEA names, required, up to 50), optionally filtered by products, flows (balance flows or price sectors), indicators (data-browser indicators such as TFCbySource, ElecGenByFuel, CO2BySector) and year range; paged with an opaque cursor over a deterministic ordering. Values are decimal strings with the source unit; null values stay null. Paid and non-CC dataset ids fail with license_restricted and the product/purchase page.

options.name: countries
options.about: Required in practice: ISO3 codes (FRA), ISO2, IEA names (France, People's Republic of China) or stats codes (FRANCE, WORLD, OECDTOT, CHINAREG).

options.name: cursor
options.about: next_cursor from the previous page of the same query; maximum offset 200000.

options.name: dataset_id
options.about: Pattern: ^[a-z0-9-]+$.

options.name: flows
options.about: Stats flow codes (TES, TFC, INDPROD, IMPORTS, EXPORTS, TOTIND, TOTTRANS, RESIDENT, ...; CO2: CO2FUEL, ELECHEAT, TOTTRANS, TOTIND, RESIDENT, ...) or price sectors (RESID, IND, TRANS, COMM, ELGEN). Not for MES.

options.name: frequency
options.about: Must match the dataset (annual highlights: A; monthly electricity statistics and monthly oil prices: M).

options.name: indicators
options.about: Data-browser indicators per dataset (see `dataset`.indicators): TESbySource, TFCbySource, TFCbySector, ElecGenByFuel, ElecConsBySector, CO2BySector, CO2Intensity; prices: PRICE, PRICE CONVERTED, HEATHOUSE, COOKING, SHOWER, CARS, PRICEMONTHLY. Cannot be combined with products/flows for stats datasets.
